en: A vintage, tinted postcard showing a calm bay or inlet framed by tall trees in the foreground. Across the water, forested shoreline and rocky outcrops are visible, with a white steamboat or ferry near a small pier. The style suggests an early 20th‑century colorized photograph. Text at the bottom left identifies the view, and smaller text at the bottom right credits the photographer/publisher.
